name: Grocy
short_description: Self-hosted grocery and household management system.
description: Grocy is a web-based self-hosted groceries and household management solution. Track products, manage shopping lists, control stock levels, plan meals, and manage chores and tasks all in one place. It includes powerful features for barcode scanning, meal planning, recipe management, and much more.
usecases: Track pantry stock and prevent food waste.
Manage shopping lists and household chores.
Plan meals and recipes based on available ingredients.
